description: File the business's US A2P 10DLC brand on its own account. Twilio: customerProfileBundleSid and a2pProfileBundleSid (the Trust Hub bundles from Twilio's guided registration), brandType STANDARD or SOLE_PROPRIETOR. Telnyx: entityType, displayName, companyName, email, vertical, plus ein, phone, street, city, state, postalCode, website as the business has them. The provider bills its registration fee to the account. Without confirm:true nothing is filed. Free in credits. Needs Hermoso phone on (activate_phone_service) or Twilio or Telnyx connected (Connectors, or connect_connector).
name: register_sms_brand
title: Register a 10DLC brand
